trial_court: PRL. CIVIL JUDGE (SR.DN.), BAILHONGAL in R.A.NO.16/2007
case_name: Smt Sangawa W/O Mallikarjun Tigadi vs Smt Savitri

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt Savitri (wife) and The Life Insurance Corporation of India (R2)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff pleaded that she is the legally wedded wife of Sri.Mallikarjun Basavanneppa Tigadi, who deserted her after putting pressure on her to get more gold and silver from her parents.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnized in violation of the requirement as to age laid down in Clause (iii) of Section 5 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is not void or even voidable.
legal_principles.held: The first argument, in this case, centered around the marriage of the plaintiff with Mallikarjun Basavennappa Tigadi is not void as concluded by the First Appellate Court

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to establish that a marriage is null and void.
legal_principles.held: The appeal of the plaintiff is pressed upon distinct grounds. Even though the appeal is argued on a wider canvas, the short and narrow question which would go to the root of the matter is; whether a marriage solemnized in violation of the requirement as to age laid down in Clause (iii) of Section 5 of the H.M Act is void.

outcome.final_order: The Court set aside the judgment and decree dated 09.06.2008 passed by the PRL. CIVIL JUDGE (SR.DN.), BAILHONGAL.
